text:
lisa: Heads-up: observed a blind spot when debugging slow responses — batch routing decisions (why a request got batched vs sent immediately) don't show up in traces or logs consistently. That makes it hard to correlate cost spikes with batching strategy.
omar: I ran some adhoc queries. we have traces with span.duration but no batch metadata. API gateway adds consumer headers but downstream rewriters drop them.
lisa: proposal: propagate a small, stable envelope of batch metadata at the edge that travels with the request through to the model runtime. Keep it minimal: batch_id, batch_mode (e.g., latency|throughput|fallback), batch_size_hint, and batch_window_ms. stamp into trace root span and as structured log fields on the response path.
trent: +1 on minimal. Suggest we do NOT attach batch_id to metric label keys to avoid cardinality. metrics should accept only reason/model/route; batch_id only in spans/logs.
nina: sampling strategy: capture 100% of batch decisions (we need to know every time something batched) but only sample token-level diffs or KV cache events (1% default). add per-tenant overrides.
kevin: storage/indexing: we shouldn't index batch_id globally. instead create a short-lived index for the last 24h for fast lookups, and only for traces that are marked sampled_for_diagnostics=true. That keeps ES/trace-store overhead bounded.
lisa: security: some private customers will want this off. add config: observability.ingress.batch_propagation.enabled with hosted=true, private=false default. Also scrub any user-provided content from token-deltas before emitting.
omar: implementation detail: put shim in edge-proxy (sidecar) so it's consistent across routes. minimal header names: X-RW-BATCH-ID, X-RW-BATCH-MODE, X-RW-BATCH-SZ, X-RW-BATCH-WIN. The shim should also emit a low-cardinality metric: rw.batcher.choice{mode,model,route}.count.
trent: sample pseudocode: 
```
// edge-sidecar request handler
batch = batcher.evaluate(req)
req.headers.set("X-RW-BATCH-ID", batch.id)
req.headers.set("X-RW-BATCH-MODE", batch.mode)
req.headers.set("X-RW-BATCH-SZ", str(batch.size_hint))
req.headers.set("X-RW-BATCH-WIN", str(batch.window_ms))
span.root.set_tag("rw.batch_id", batch.id)
span.root.set_tag("rw.batch_mode", batch.mode)
metric.emit("rw.batcher.choice", 1, {mode:batch.mode, model:req.model, route:req.route})
if random() < sampling_rate: emit_event("rw.token_delta", scrub(token_delta))
```
nina: need to make scrub(token_delta) run through our pii-scrubber lib. also provide an opt-in to include cache-hit counts vs raw token content. prefer counts by default.
kevin: for dashboards, derive an aggregated table: batch_metrics_{day} with cols: date, model, route, mode, total_batches, avg_batch_size, sample_token_deltas_count. This avoids expensive trace joins for common queries.
lisa: rollout plan: 1) prototype shim in staging (omar + trent) 2) add sampling & scrub util (nina) 3) indexing policy + dashboard derived table (kevin) 4) update onboard docs + private defaults (lisa). target: first pass in 2 sprints.
omar: I'll open a tiny RFC with the header contract and the sample proto for the token_delta event. will call out privacy and index cost tradeoffs.
trent: starting a branch for the edge change. leaving thread open for comments. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy of edge-proxy v3.15 to staging at 3377777877 :rocket:
